title: Product multilinear random variable
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a$ be a real-valued coefficient function on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and for each $i\in\text{Fin}(n)$ let $X_i$ be a real-valued function on a type $\Omega_i$. For a tuple $\omega$ with $\omega_i\in\Omega_i$, the associated product multilinear random variable is the product multilinear polynomial with coefficients $a$, evaluated at the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $X_i(\omega_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued coefficient function on finite subsets of $\text{Fin}(n)$
Tuple $\omega$ with coordinates in the corresponding $\Omega_i$
